battle.name: 橘子戰爭
battle.theater: 荷蘭海爾德蘭省蓋爾德馬爾森
battle.brief: 1801年二月至五月，法軍趁《亞眠和約》生效之際越過萊茵河，與巴達維亞共和國民兵在荷蘭本土短兵相接，戰鬥集中於四月萊克河與瓦爾河一線。荷軍以公民民兵為骨幹，早期後膛的輪發槍已給燧發手槍取代，只在軍官與衛兵手中充當值勤近衛之具；實戰不過數日即告收場。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 交戰一方是法國第一共和國。1801年春天，法國以拿破崙的戰爭機器為後盾，由元帥貝蒂耶率領一支由步兵師、騎兵旅與工兵部隊組成的一個軍團，自萊茵河下游向荷蘭境內推進；軍中士兵多數是經過意大利戰役與埃及遠征的老兵，屬於當時歐洲最精良的職業軍隊，另一支由莫蒂埃指揮的師級部隊負責突破渡口與追擊。另一方是巴達維亞共和國，即荷蘭本土議會體系下的國家：軍隊主體是各州民兵、烏得勒支與海牙的國民警衛隊，以及為數不多的職業正規軍，由范凱佩爾與范赫爾登兩位將領分節指揮，依托萊克河與瓦爾河一帶的水網地勢固守。第三方是英國與俄國：英國以海上封鎖、供應軍火與少量部隊支援荷方，並由外交大臣在倫敦與巴黎之間斡旋；俄國曾派出一支規模有限的陸軍部隊在荷蘭登陸，協助奧蘭治派奪取政權。西班牙在歐洲戰線上雖與法國結盟，但沒有部隊投入荷蘭。整體而言，交戰雙方實力極為懸殊，一方是以國家軍隊為主、經過多次大會戰洗禮的正規軍團，另一方是以公民民兵為主、訓練與裝備都不完整的國防軍，戰役規模亦極小。
countriesEn: One belligerent was the French First Republic. In the spring of 1801, backed by the full weight of Napoleon's war machine, France sent a corps under Marshal Berthier, made up of infantry divisions, cavalry brigades and engineer detachments, advancing into the Netherlands from the lower Rhine; most of its soldiers were veterans of the Italian campaigns and the Egyptian expedition, and it counted among the best professional armies in Europe, while a division-level force under Mortier was responsible for breaking the river crossings and for the pursuit. The other side was the Batavian Republic, the state built on the institutions of the Dutch estates and assemblies: its army was composed chiefly of provincial militias, the civic guards of Utrecht and The Hague, and a small body of regular professionals, commanded in sections by the generals Van Keppel and Van Heerden, and holding ground in the watery terrain of the Lek and the Waal. Third parties were Britain and Russia: Britain supported the Dutch by blockade, by supplying powder and arms, and with a limited number of troops, while its foreign secretary negotiated in London and Paris; Russia sent a small corps of soldiers to land in the Netherlands and to help the Orangist faction take power. Spain, though an ally of France on the European front, committed no troops to the Netherlands. The balance of power was therefore lopsided: on one side a national field army hardened by repeated pitched battles, on the other a defence force of citizen militia deficient in training and equipment. The scale of the campaign was correspondingly small.
people: 拿破崙·波拿巴是這場戰爭背後的實際決策者，但他人一直在巴黎，前線並無他的身影，只以命令與參謀部公文遙控。荷軍一方的關鍵人物有兩位：范凱佩爾負責全線指揮，範圍從海岸口岸一直到內陸的關鍵據點；范赫爾登率領中部與東部的民兵防線，立場較為強硬，主張以縱深抵抗消耗法軍。奧蘭治黨領袖威廉五世在英俄支持下於1801年2月重返海牙，在改組後的巴達維亞聯邦體制下出任陸軍上將總司令，是荷蘭新政權的象徵。維爾赫爾等人主持巴達維亞共和國的行政，在法軍進逼之下選擇向法國靠攏以保住政權。英國方面的關鍵人物是外交大臣霍克斯伯里勳爵，他在倫敦與巴黎之間的談判，令法英對抗暫時降溫；海上則由皇家海軍分遣艦隊在北海與英吉利海峽封鎖荷蘭貿易、掩護運補船隊。俄國援軍由沙皇陸軍一名將領率領，人數有限，抵達後主要擔負佔領與維持治安。法軍方面，貝蒂耶元帥主持全軍，步兵、騎兵與工兵各級指揮官按拿破崙式樣分進合擊，各司其職。
peopleEn: Napoleon Bonaparte was the man actually making the decisions behind this war, but he remained in Paris and never appeared on the front, directing everything through orders and the paperwork of the staff. Two figures stand out on the Dutch side: Van Keppel held overall command of the line, from the coastal ports to the inland strongholds, while Van Heerden led the militia defences of the centre and the east and took the harder line, favouring a war of delay in depth to wear down the French. The Orangist leader William V returned to The Hague in February 1801 with British and Russian backing, and as Captain-General of the armed forces of the reorganised Batavian Commonwealth he became the symbol of the new Dutch polity. Ver Huell and his colleagues directed the executive of the Batavian Republic and, pressed by the advancing French, chose to draw near to France in order to keep their offices. On the British side the pivotal personality was the foreign secretary, Lord Hawkesbury, whose negotiations between London and Paris cooled the Anglo-French confrontation for the time being; at sea, detachments of the Royal Navy blockaded Dutch trade in the North Sea and the English Channel and escorted supply convoys. The Russian relief force was led by a general of the tsar's army, small in numbers, and once ashore was employed mainly to hold ground and keep order. On the French side Marshal Berthier commanded the whole force, with infantry, cavalry and engineer officers working as separate echelons in the classic Napoleonic manner.
kits: 本卡兵器輪發槍是西班牙系統的早期後膛手槍：以機械絞輪帶動擊錘、靠火繩點燃底火，機構精巧但昂貴、怕潮濕，連續射擊亦容易失靈。到1801年，這種設計在歐洲主戰裝備中早已被燧發手槍取代，只有西班牙近衛隊、擲彈兵以及部分義大利與那不勒斯單位的軍官、衛兵仍零星配用。史籍對本場戰爭記載有限，並無可靠文獻顯示交戰中有人使用輪發槍；可以確定的是，它在當時的體系中只是軍官與衛兵的值勤配備，用於警衛、傳令、騎乘與近距離自衛，而非野戰火力。荷軍的野戰骨幹是滑膛燧發長槍，相當一部分得自英國援助，形制與英軍的褐貝斯式樣相近，另有荷蘭自製的十八世紀末槍械；騎兵配卡賓槍與燧發手槍；炮兵為六磅、十二磅野戰炮與榴彈炮，多屬早期十八世紀樣式或其仿製品，並沿用科霍恩式的稜堡角堡技術，在萊克河沿岸構築固定砲位與土壘。法軍步兵使用沙爾勒夫一七七七年式燧發長槍，野戰炮以四磅格里博瓦系統為主，配八磅與十二磅榴彈炮，騎兵用一七九七年式手槍與卡賓槍，工兵攜浮橋與攻城器材，但本役基本沒有真正攻城之事。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card, the wheellock pistol, is an early Spanish-pattern breech-loading handgun: a mechanical wheel draws the cock back, the match cord ignites the priming pan, and the mechanism, though ingenious, is expensive, suffers badly from damp, and is prone to misfire in rapid shooting. By 1801 the design had long been displaced by the flintlock pistol in European field service, and only the Spanish guards, the grenadiers and a few Italian and Neapolitan units still carried it in scattered numbers. The record of this war is thin, and no reliable source shows the wheellock being used in the actual fighting; what can be said with confidence is that in the order of battle of 1801 it was a duty weapon of officers and guards, for police, dispatch work, riding and close personal defence, and not a battle arm. The backbone of the Dutch field army was the smooth-bore flintlock musket, a large share of them supplied by Britain and closely resembling the Brown Bess pattern, supplemented by Dutch-made late eighteenth-century muskets; cavalry carried carbines and flintlock pistols, and the artillery fielded six- and twelve-pounder guns and howitzers, mostly early eighteenth-century patterns or copies of them, while the old Coehoorn tradition of bastion and ravelin fortification was still visible in the fixed batteries and earthen works dug along the Lek. The French infantry used the Charleville 1777 flintlock musket; their field artillery was built around the four-pounder Gribeauval system with eight- and twelve-pounder howitzers, the cavalry carried 1797 pattern pistols and carbines, and the engineers brought pontoon bridge and siege equipment, although no genuine siege was fought in this campaign.
tactics: 荷軍整體採取守勢與遲滯抵抗。民兵被編為多道防線，沿萊克河與瓦爾河構成縱深相接的多重防線體系，依託堤壩、氾濫地與人工壕溝，把主力集中在可以退守的節點上，避免與法軍做正面會戰；國民警衛隊則守護城鎮、運河樞紐與軍需倉庫。三月這一部署尚能奏效，但四月初法軍主力越境後，荷軍在局部出現急躁的攻擊：4月8日蓋爾德馬爾森方向，民兵主動出擊法軍前哨，未經協同即強攻，遭到集中炮火與步兵反擊而退回，暴露民兵缺乏訓練與統一指揮的弱點。4月17至18日，祖德－威廉斯瓦特一線，法軍以縱隊沿軍用道路急行，切斷荷軍側翼，荷軍在退卻中被分割，陣線隨即崩潰，國民警衛隊退入城鎮。法軍的戰術完全按拿破崙式樣運作：縱隊晝夜行軍，以師為單位分進合擊，奪取渡口與橋樑，集中火炮實施速射與縱深射擊，並避免在有利地形上與守軍拼消耗，而是利用對方分兵、反應遲緩的弱點切入。補給上，荷軍糧秣靠多德雷赫特與鹿特丹方向的河運，儲備有限；法軍靠萊茵河沿岸徵發與車隊接濟，每日行軍約二十至二十五公里。戰事同時帶有明確政治目標：法軍自稱只為執行《亞眠和約》、消除英俄對荷蘭的影響。
tacticsEn: The Dutch on the whole fought a defensive battle of delay. The militia was organised into several lines, forming a system of mutually supporting positions in depth along the Lek and the Waal, relying on dikes, flooded ground and artificial ditches, and concentrating the main body on points that could be held and fallen back from, in order to avoid a pitched engagement with the French; the civic guards were set to hold the towns, the canal junctions and the magazine depots. Through March this arrangement held together, but once the main French force crossed the border in early April the Dutch grew impatient in places: on 8 April, in the Geldermalsen sector, the militia attacked a French outpost on its own initiative and without coordination, was met by concentrated artillery fire and an infantry counter-attack, and fell back, exposing the weakness of troops with neither training nor a common command. On 17 and 18 April, along the Zuid-Willemsvaart, the French marched in column along the military roads, cut the Dutch flank, divided the withdrawing force and broke the line, the civic guards retiring into the towns. French method followed the Napoleonic template in every respect: columns on the march by day and by night, divisions acting independently and in concert, seizure of fords and bridges, artillery massed for rapid fire and for fire in depth, and a deliberate refusal to waste strength against a defender in favourable ground, seeking instead the gaps opened by the enemy's dispersal and slow reactions. On the supply side the Dutch drew rations by barge from the direction of Dordrecht and Rotterdam, and their stocks were thin; the French subsisted on requisitions along the Rhine and on their wagon columns, marching some twenty to twenty-five kilometres a day. The campaign carried an overt political purpose as well: France presented the war as the enforcement of the Peace of Amiens and the removal of British and Russian influence from the Netherlands.
data: 可以寫而有根據的數字有限，並且各方記錄互相矛盾。交戰時段主要集中於1801年4月，實戰日數以日計，戰爭自2月的政變與越境到5月降級，前後約三個月。荷軍方面，動員兵力一般記為三萬至四萬人，其中絕大多數是民兵與警衛隊，職業正規軍只有數千。對手一方的法軍，通常記述為貝蒂耶率領之一個軍團，兵員約兩萬上下，不同史料數目互有出入，戰役中分遣支隊沿萊茵河多處渡口同時推進。地理上，蓋爾德馬爾森在阿姆斯特丹西南約六十公里，祖德－威廉斯瓦特位於奈梅嫩以西的萊茵河下游地帶，荷軍的主要防線沿萊克河展開超過一百公里。損失方面沒有可信的統一統計，可以確定的只是荷軍被俘人數以數百計，其餘傷亡數字各方說法互相矛盾，法軍相對損失輕微。氣候與地形是重要變數，四月的荷蘭低地多雨多霧、地面泥濘，荷軍民兵多沿堤壩與道路行軍，展開與補給都受限制；法軍則靠馬匹與技術較好的炮兵維持推進速度。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are few, and the accounts contradict one another. The fighting was concentrated in April 1801, and the number of days of actual contact is counted in days rather than weeks; from the February coup and the first border crossings to the general reduction of hostilities in May the affair ran for roughly three months. On the Dutch side the force mobilised is generally given as thirty to forty thousand men, of whom the overwhelming majority were militia and civic guards, with only a few thousand regular professionals. The French force is usually described as a single corps under Berthier of about twenty thousand men, though the numbers differ from source to source, and detachments were pushed forward simultaneously at several crossings on the Rhine. Geographically, Geldermalsen lies about sixty kilometres south-west of Amsterdam, the Zuid-Willemsvaart sector sits on the lower Rhine west of Nijmegen, and the Dutch line along the Lek extended over a hundred kilometres. On losses there is no trustworthy uniform count: what can be said is that Dutch prisoners taken numbered in the hundreds, the remaining casualty figures are mutually contradictory, and French losses were comparatively light. Weather and ground were decisive variables; the low Netherlands in April are rainy and foggy with heavy mud, the Dutch militia moving largely along dikes and roads with deployment and supply restricted accordingly, while the French kept their rate of advance with the help of horses and a technically superior artillery.
cause: 直接起因是法國與荷蘭之間關於軍隊指揮權與國家主權的衝突。拿破崙要求巴達維亞共和國把國家軍隊併入法軍序列、為法國在西班牙方向的戰爭提供兵員與基地，並要求荷方接受由法國主導的貿易限制；荷蘭執政團隊在商船被英國封鎖、轉口貿易崩塌的壓力之下，逐步採取強硬態度。1800年法軍一度越境接管荷蘭邊境要塞、徵用軍費並限制英貨進口，引起軍方不滿與議會反對；1801年1月法軍再度越界接管要塞，荷軍小股部隊與之發生衝突，雙方關係遂告破裂。2月，在英國海上支援與俄國陸軍支援下，奧蘭治派在海牙得勢，威廉五世復位，荷蘭新政府對《亞眠和約》的落實提出保留並要求英國提供保障，英國亦藉此把荷蘭牢牢拉向對法陣線。與此同時，法國在庇里牛斯山區擊敗西班牙，得以抽出手來處理北面的事端。導火線是4月初法軍主力越過荷軍前沿、佔領邊境要塞並向萊克河推進，荷軍前哨與民兵零星接火後，戰事迅速擴大為全面衝突。
causeEn: The immediate cause lay in the quarrel between France and the Netherlands over command of the army and over national sovereignty. Napoleon required the Batavian Republic to fold its national forces into the French order of battle, to supply troops and bases for the French war in Spain, and to accept trade restrictions dictated by Paris; the governing directory, squeezed by the British blockade and the collapse of the transit trade on which the Dutch economy depended, grew steadily more assertive. In 1800 French troops crossed the border to take over frontier fortresses, levy war costs and restrict the entry of British goods, provoking resentment in the army and opposition in the assemblies; in January 1801 the French again crossed to take over fortresses, small Dutch detachments clashed with them, and the rupture became complete. In February, with British support at sea and a Russian corps ashore, the Orangists carried the day at The Hague, William V was restored, the new Dutch government made reservations about the execution of the Peace of Amiens and asked for British guarantees, and Britain used the occasion to pull the Netherlands firmly onto the anti-French camp. At the same time France had beaten Spain in the Pyrenees and could turn its attention northward. The spark was the crossing of the Dutch outposts by the main French force in early April, the seizure of the frontier fortresses and the advance towards the Lek, after which the first skirmishes between outposts and militia grew within days into a general conflict.
impact: 對荷蘭而言，這是一場改變國家體制的戰爭。巴達維亞共和國在1801年4月被改組為巴達維亞聯邦，頒行新憲法，設立由威廉五世出任的聯邦執政，土地制度與中央集權同時被重整；但真正的權力在法國手裡，荷蘭變成一個受佔領、隨法國意圖而動的附庸，直到1803年再度開戰、1810年被併入法蘭西王國、1813年才隨拿破崙垮台而重獲自由。對英國而言，荷蘭被牢牢綁上反法的戰車，第三次反法同盟的籌備因此更為順利，荷蘭的港口與海軍分艦隊成為英國在北海的支撐點。對荷蘭軍隊而言，這場戰爭是對公民民兵制度的一次殘酷檢驗：民兵缺乏訓練、彈藥與統一指揮，證明無法抵擋職業化軍團，荷蘭此後重建常備軍，並在法國推行的法式徵兵、兵役與炮兵制度之下進行改革，設防、攻城與後勤都朝法式靠攏，海軍亦獲得更新。殖民地方面，因歐洲戰事牽動，英國在爪哇、錫蘭與好望角的擴張得以鞏固，而荷屬印度與遠東的商路飽受封鎖之苦。整體而言，這場規模微小、延續不過數月的衝突，是荷蘭喪失獨立自主、並在下一個十年被法國吞併的起點。
impactEn: For the Netherlands this was a war that changed the shape of the state. In April 1801 the Batavian Republic was reorganised as the Batavian Commonwealth, a new constitution was promulgated and the federal Captain-General was given to William V, landholding arrangements and central authority being recast at the same time; but the real power lay in French hands, and the Netherlands became an occupied dependency subject to French wishes, remaining so until war resumed in 1803, until incorporation into the French Empire in 1810, and until freedom returned in 1813 with the collapse of Napoleon. For Britain the Netherlands was now bound tight to the anti-French cause, and the preparations for the Third Coalition were thereby made easier, the Dutch ports and squadrons becoming British footholds in the North Sea. For the Dutch army the campaign was a brutal audit of the citizen militia: without training, powder or a common command it could not stand against a professional corps, and the country afterwards rebuilt a standing army and reformed its recruiting, service, artillery and engineering on the French model then being imposed on it. On the colonial side, the European fighting gave the British their consolidation in Java, Ceylon and the Cape, while the Dutch trade with India and the Far East suffered under blockade. Taken as a whole, this small and short war was the opening of the period in which the Netherlands lost its independence and was swallowed by France within the following decade.
result: 法軍以極小代價贏得了戰略目標。4月中下旬，法軍相繼攻入荷蘭中部與北部，奪取主要渡口、橋樑與交通線，荷軍主力在祖德－威廉斯瓦特方向崩潰之後被解散或解除武裝，部分民兵退回城鎮，國民警衛隊則繼續守城。法軍進駐阿姆斯特丹及周邊要地，組建軍管當局，荷蘭新政府在法國監護下運作；5月衝突降級為停火，法軍保留佔領區，等《亞眠和約》全面落實後於下半年陸續撤出北部。威廉五世保住奧蘭治親王與國家元首的名位，卻失去實權，荷蘭以巴達維亞聯邦的名義維持形式上的獨立。對荷蘭軍方而言，結果是國防軍被解散、常備軍重建、軍制全面法式化，且荷蘭的獨立自此要等到拿破崙戰敗後才會恢復。戰爭名稱沿用至今，成為歐洲近代史上少數以一種水果命名的戰事，也是「不打而勝」的例子：荷軍以數萬民兵面對一整個法軍團，交火不過數日，勝負幾乎在開火之前就已經決定。
resultEn: France won its strategic object at very small cost. Through the second half of April the French took successively the centre and the north of the country, seizing the principal fords, bridges and lines of communication; after the collapse of the Dutch main body in the Zuid-Willemsvaart sector the militia was disbanded or disarmed, some men withdrawing into the towns while the civic guards held the cities. French troops occupied Amsterdam and the neighbouring strong points and set up a military administration, and the new Dutch government continued to function under French supervision. In May the fighting was reduced to a truce, the French keeping their occupied ground until the Peace of Amiens was fully executed and then withdrawing from the north in the latter half of the year. William V kept the titles of stadtholder and head of state but not the substance of power, and the Netherlands preserved a formal independence under the name of the Batavian Commonwealth. For the Dutch military the outcome was the dissolution of the defence militia, the rebuilding of a standing army and the wholesale French-isation of the service, with real independence not to return until after Napoleon's defeat. The name of the war has survived into the present as one of the few European conflicts named after a fruit, and it stands as an example of a war won without being fought: several tens of thousands of Dutch militia faced a whole French corps, the two sides exchanged fire for only a handful of days, and the outcome was very nearly settled before the first shot was fired.
